question: In email, what does the acronym ‘CC’ stand for?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Carbon copy.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term carbon copy or more commonly, “CC” is used in e-mail.
 
• We use CC in email means you're sending an email not only to the primary recipient in the “To” field i.e. "To CC", but also to one or more secondary recipients.
 
• In Gmail, you can CC up to 100 recipients in any one email.
 
• This saves time and ensures better communication.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__Steps to include CC in a mail:

 
• Compose a mail.
 
• Add the name to whom you want to send the mail in the 'to' field.
 
• Then, click CC in the top right of the email.
 
• Insert the secondary recipients' email addresses.
